name: The Woodpaw Gnolls
summary: In southern Feralas, you search Woodpaw camps for Raschal, the courier. After Quintis's vision, Ginro Hearthkindle sends you to find him or his belongings, though Ginro doubts the gnolls were his undoing.

sections.title: Where to Start Looking
sections.body:
Ginro Hearthkindle admits the Woodpaw, whom Ginro calls “friends,” may have done for Raschal after all. Still, Ginro feels the gnolls were not responsible, and their camps are the best place to start. Ginro has no clearer plan than to search them.

Gnolls keep what they scavenge and fight over it, so they may have found the backpacks Quintis mentioned. Ginro once avoided open fighting during earlier searches. Now the vision guides you, and Ginro says to rip into them. The camps lie in southern Feralas.

sections.title: At the Camps
sections.body: In the Lower Wilds, two large leather backpacks are tacked to a nearby tree. Each bears a small insignia of Feathermoon Stronghold on its front.

faq.answer: Ginro Hearthkindle is searching for Raschal, the courier. Ginro wants evidence of Raschal or his belongings.

faq.q: Why search the Woodpaw gnoll camps?
faq.answer: Ginro says the Woodpaw camps are the best place to start. Gnolls keep what they scavenge and fight over it, so they may have found the backpacks Quintis mentioned.

faq.q: Where did the clue about the backpacks come from?
aliases: how does ginro know about backpacks
faq.answer: Quintis Jonespyre mentioned the backpacks in his vision of Raschal taking two large leather backpacks from the boat.
The Woodpaw camps lie in southern Feralas.
